title: What still leases
intro: Not a vibe. A spec. If the building cannot clear this bar, it is a conversion or a hold — not a lease-up.

mustHaves.label: Floor plate
mustHaves.detail: 18–28k RSF typical; larger plates need a campus story.

mustHaves.label: Power
mustHaves.detail: 6–8+ W/sf delivered, with a path to 12+ on AI / lab floors.

mustHaves.label: HVAC / air
mustHaves.detail: Modern VAV or lab-capable; operable story if you can tell it honestly.

mustHaves.label: Arrival
mustHaves.detail: Lobby, security, and street that a VP will walk a candidate through.

dealKillers: Single-stair / life-safety that blocks conversion or densification
Landlord who will not spend on systems
Ground-floor vacancy that reads as abandonment
